evidence.why: Shows attachment admission, request initialization and 512-byte continuation.
Mount-stage system-block reads precede final mount verification and API completion.

facts.rationale: The entry point checks attached rather than completed mount state. The mounting implementation calls this helper before its continuation reaches final verification.
facts.value: Initializes and launches an asynchronous bulk read on an attached memory-card channel, dividing the requested segment-multiple length into 512-byte segments whose completion callback advances the request until all data has been transferred or an error occurs. This helper also reads system blocks during mounting; successful mount completion is not its admission condition.
